question: The average weight of Tushar, Salil and Mukund is 45 kg. If the average weight of Tushar and Salil is 44 kg and that of Salil and Mukund is 47 kg, then the weight of Salil (in kg) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total weight of Tushar, Salil and Mukund = 45 × 3 = 135 kg

Total weight of (Tushar + Salil) = 44 × 2 = 88 kg

Total weight of (Salil + Mukund) = 47 × 2 = 94 kg

Weight of Salil = (Sum of overlapping groups) − (Total weight)

⇒ Salil's weight = (88 + 94) − 135 = 182 − 135 = 47 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 47 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of Tushar (T), Salil (S), and Mukund (M) = 45 kg

Average weight of Tushar and Salil = 44 kg

Average weight of Salil and Mukund = 47 kg

 
 

 Total (T + S + M) = 135 kg

 
 

 T + S = 88 kg

 
 
 T

 
 S (Overlap)

 
 M

 
 

 S + M = 94 kg

 
 S = (T + S) + (S + M) − Total = 88 + 94 − 135 = 47

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of all three (T + S + M) = 45 × 3 = 135 kg ... (i)

⇒ Weight of Tushar and Salil (T + S) = 44 × 2 = 88 kg ... (ii)

⇒ Weight of Salil and Mukund (S + M) = 47 × 2 = 94 kg ... (iii)

Adding equations (ii) and (iii):

⇒ (T + S) + (S + M) = 88 + 94

⇒ T + 2S + M = 182 kg

Subtracting equation (i) from the sum above isolates Salil's weight:

⇒ (T + 2S + M) − (T + S + M) = 182 − 135

⇒ S = 47 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 47 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overlapping Groups (Inclusion/Exclusion Method)

When solving average questions where one person or item is counted twice in subsets, the value of the overlapping entity is equal to the sum of the subsets minus the sum of the entire group.

Basic Average Rule

The fundamental formula for average dictates that Total Sum = Average × Number of entities. Any change in average multiplied by the base count translates to the net difference in the total sum.

Replacement in Averages

When a new member replaces an existing member, the New Member's value = Replaced Member's value + (Change in Average × Total Number of Members). This avoids recalculating the entire sum manually.
